record.original_question: Determine the exact covering radius of the Kerdock code K_m described in reference [37].

evidence.quote: Open Question 12.7. Find the exact covering radius of Km (Kerdock code) described in [37].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive even integer $m$, the Kerdock code $K_m$ is a nonlinear binary code of length $2^m$, size $2^{2m}$, and minimum distance $2^{m-1}-2^{(m-2)/2}$, defined as the union of the first-order Reed–Muller code $\mathrm{RM}(1,m)$ with $2^{m-1}-1$ of its cosets in $\mathrm{RM}(2,m)$ chosen so that the symmetric difference of the supports of any two distinct cosets contains a coset of weight $\geq 2^{m-1}-2^{(m-2)/2}$. The covering radius of a binary code $C \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ is defined as
$$\rho(C) = \max_{x \in \mathbb{F}_2^n} \min_{c \in C} d_H(x,c),$$
where $d_H$ denotes Hamming distance.

Determine the exact value of the covering radius $\rho(K_m)$ as a function of $m$.
artifact.category_tag: Covering radius of nonlinear binary codes
artifact.status_search_result: A brief web search did not surface a result establishing the exact covering radius of the Kerdock codes $K_m$ in general; only bounds and special-case results are visible in covering-radius surveys. The problem appears to remain open, consistent with its listing as an open question, but no definitive resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Covering Radius — Survey and Recent Results
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing covering radii of various classical codes and noting many gaps between known bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys on covering radius treat Kerdock-type codes among cases where only bounds are known.

status_evidence.title: A Brief Survey of Covering Radius
status_evidence.snippet: Brief survey of covering radius problems indicating many cases remain open.
status_evidence.claim: No exact covering radius formula for Kerdock codes is reported.
